page.overview:
Who is Candy Nanny?

She is an elderly Candy Person who lacks both arms and legs. Her body is a greenish gray and is covered with paint splatters from the Candy Kids. Her eyes are closed, and she has slight wrinkles on her face. She has mostly short, white hair, but the hair on the right side of her head is brown (possibly because one of the Candy Kids painted it).
